research_question: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE（合成演示，非真实案例）——在确诊2型糖尿病的成人患者中，SGLT2抑制剂相较安慰剂或常规治疗能否改善心血管结局？仅考察经同行评议发表的随机对照试验证据。
queries: SGLT2 inhibitor type 2 diabetes cardiovascular outcomes randomized trial
empagliflozin placebo cardiovascular outcome adults T2DM RCT

inclusion: 纳入确诊2型糖尿病的成人患者（年龄≥18岁）的临床研究。
干预措施为SGLT2抑制剂单用或联合用药，对照为安慰剂或常规治疗。
研究设计为随机对照试验（RCT），发表于经同行评议的期刊，并报告至少一项心血管结局。

candidates.title: Empagliflozin and cardiovascular outcomes in adults with type 2 diabetes: a randomized controlled trial
candidates.abstract: In this double-blind, randomized controlled trial, 1,208 adults (aged 45 to 79 years) with type 2 diabetes were assigned to empagliflozin 10 mg daily or placebo. The primary composite cardiovascular outcome (cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or nonfatal stroke) occurred in 8.1% of the empagliflozin group and 10.4% of the placebo group over a median follow-up of 3.1 years.

candidates.title: Empagliflozin versus placebo in adolescents with type 2 diabetes: a randomized trial
candidates.abstract: We randomly assigned 214 adolescents (aged 12 to 17 years) with type 2 diabetes to receive once-daily empagliflozin or placebo for 52 weeks. Glycemic control improved, and exploratory cardiovascular endpoints were similar between groups.
